resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives coordinates for the site, but its detail page says the exact location of the post is unknown. The story reports the removal and location uncertainty and does not present the coordinates as a confirmed site.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one register detail page, one Forest Lookouts page that credits Irma Oksen Reaves's 1988 book, and the register list. The register credits its photo to that book but gives no image URL, so no photo entry was added. Search snippets mention a 2026 Plaskett Fire in Monterey County, but none of the pages read tie it to this site, so the story does not mention it. No source says whether the public can reach the area.
